propositions: Manual attempt scheduler in _pai_structured must be replaced with one bounded Agent operation that preserves full history and shared request budget

Wire-context HistoryProcessor projection must include/omit ModelResponse based on token fit (input_tokens + output_tokens + effective_max_tokens <= window), never partially, omitting whole response or failing closed with ContextWindowExceededError on authoritative-input overflow

Prompted-branch concision guard must read finish_reason at two layers (response.usage and provider_details) for length/max_tokens truncation signals, retry with ModelRetry, and delegate other cases to shared check_response logic
NativeOutput branch must preserve output_mode selection, bug-895c fallback, pai_output.guard_capability (not concision guard), and terminal truncation behavior

Request budget must compose base allowance (ceil(eff_max_iter/2)) plus output-retry allowance (derived from OUTPUT_RETRIES) in one UsageLimits, with no per-attempt reset and no per-candidate budget recalculation

Shared output-retry counter (pydantic-ai retries={"output": N}) must bound both concision ModelRetry (guard hook) and validation ModelRetry (TextOutput function), raising UnexpectedModelBehavior at exhaustion
